7_GLY.pqr.provenance: Author-supplied PQR input used for the 7_GLY experiment; released at the author's request. Original upstream attribution is not established by this manifest.
7_GLY.pqr.usage: Coordinates and radii define the sphere-union geometry. Atomic charges are not used in the Laplace experiment.

flower_geometry.mat.provenance: Synthetic five-lobed domain with three elliptical holes used in the reported experiment. Numeric geometry and P1 stiffness fields only.
flower_geometry.mat.export: Retains all arrays read by load_geometry; unused solver settings and matrices omitted.

TSLlaplace2D_(200, 51).txt.provenance: Exact held-out GRF-boundary Laplace Test Set 2 used for the reported paired comparison.
TSLlaplace2D_(200, 51).txt.ordering: TextDataset layout: each sample contains boundary values followed by flattened solution values.
